Independently identify test scenarios based on business requirements discussed in story grooming and backlog grooming and work with the BA and Scrum Master to capture acceptance tests.
Perform multiple forms of testing (manual and automation) for both front and back end code.
Document test cases and results such as test reports, requirements traceability matrix.
Troubleshoot and mitigate issues, suggesting fixes where applicable and tracking issues through mitigation.
Facilitate testing improvements by recommending best practices, supporting other testers, and sharing knowledge of test tools.
Automate test scripts using automated testing software so they can quickly be referenced and re-executed with minimal human intervention.
Participate in lower environment integration testing and production deployment verification testing efforts.
cond_0012.requirements:
Around 5 years of experience in software testing and quality assurance, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in an Agile environment - preferably Scrum methodology using tools like Jira, Confluence and Zephyr.
Working knowledge of systems testing and evaluation principles, methods, and tools.
Experience with automated testing tools like Selenium and JMeter.
Familiarity with section 508 compliance standards.
Background in requirement analysis principles and methods.
A positive, proactive attitude with good listening skills and a willingness to collaborate and learn.
Ability to think and act strategically and proactively.
Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
BA/BS in a related field, or equivalent practical experience, preferred.
Ability to obtain public trust clearance, or willingness to pursue it.
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally, including writing clear and concise technical architecture documents.

Independently identify test scenarios based on business requirements discussed in story grooming and backlog grooming and work with the BA and Scrum Master to capture acceptance tests.
Perform multiple forms of testing (manual and automation) for both front and back end code.
Document test cases and results such as test reports, requirements traceability matrix.
Troubleshoot and mitigate issues, suggesting fixes where applicable and tracking issues through mitigation.
Facilitate testing improvements by recommending best practices, supporting other testers, and sharing knowledge of test tools.
Automate test scripts using automated testing software so they can quickly be referenced and re-executed with minimal human intervention.
Participate in lower environment integration testing and production deployment verification testing efforts.
cond_0346.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in software testing and quality assurance
Knowledge of systems testing and evaluation principles, methods, and tools
Knowledge and experience with automated testing tools like Selenium and JMeter
Knowledge of requirement analysis principles and methods
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to write clear and concise technical architecture documents
The candidates should have the ability to obtain public trust clearance
Preferred Requirements
Experience in an Agile environment - preferably Scrum methodology using tools like Jira, Confluence and Zephyr
Knowledge and experience with section 508 compliance standards
Enthusiastic, proactive, positive attitude with great listening skills and high integrity
Ability to think and act strategically and proactively
Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail
BA/BS in a related field (or with equivalent experience)
